tasks.title: Hosted repository and durable checkpoint; inspect quota gate
tasks.acceptance: Verify hosted fork/checkpoint; document budget enforcement as available or blocked. No recurring model tasks without admission.

tasks.title: C reference build and recording calibration
tasks.acceptance: Build on hosted Linux; compare representative public inputs with exact scorer; separate libc/path/TZ differences.

tasks.title: Source map, provenance and branch contracts
tasks.acceptance: Map C/Lua functions, shared state, calls and effects; no executable C-to-JS emitter.

tasks.title: RNG and C numeric semantics
tasks.acceptance: Direct LLM port of wrappers/helpers verified against C; no RNG-only correctness claims.

tasks.title: Input suspension and terminal boundary
tasks.acceptance: Before-input capture, menus, More, cancellation and reset tests; log known frozen serializer defect.

tasks.title: Lua and dungeon dependency decision
tasks.acceptance: Inspect actual initialization and Lua reachability; directly port level scripts/bindings; declare unsupported paths.

tasks.title: Options, character creation and object initialization
tasks.acceptance: State and output match for multiple real configurations.

tasks.title: Level generation and first honest playable session
tasks.acceptance: Replace reachable fastforward scaffolding; pass starter plus independent seeds without replay special cases.

tasks.title: Movement, turns, monsters and inventory
tasks.acceptance: Source-guided functional batches; first divergence and hidden-state checks.

tasks.title: Save, restore, bones and multi-game state
tasks.acceptance: Persist through canonical VFS; isolation between games and sessions.

tasks.title: Spells, shops, quests and remaining interactions
tasks.acceptance: Choose source gaps by dependency and hidden-case impact, not easy tests.

tasks.title: Generalization campaign
tasks.acceptance: Validation families plus sealed audit partition; mutation checks; no endless easy-case growth.

tasks.title: Phase 2 change rehearsal
tasks.acceptance: C patch to source-aligned JS patch; measured normalized diff and model cost.

tasks.title: Hosted unattended pilot
tasks.acceptance: Only after quota admission is enforceable: real scheduled bounded edit/test/checkpoint round trip, fresh-checkout resume and stop test, no Mac/VPS.
